item.title: Emirates suspends Dubai flights after regional airspace closures amid rising Middle East tensions
item.description: Emirates has suspended all flights to and from Dubai until March 2 due to regional airspace closures. The airline has offered passengers rebooking and refund options while urging travelers to check flight status as tensions continue to disrupt aviation routes.

item.title: The MTA Speaks: Inside the US-Israel strikes on Iran; Timeline, fallout and what the future holds?
item.description: Tensions in West Asia are rising after reported US–Israel strikes inside Iran triggered retaliation and global reactions. With oil routes, global security and diplomacy at stake, experts warn the crisis could reshape geopolitics.

item.title: India Steps onto Global Cultural Stage with Historic Debut at Youth Delphic Games 2026
item.description: India will make its historic debut at the 1st Youth Delphic Games in Bishkek, leading a 65-member delegation of young artists. The participation marks a significant step in cultural diplomacy, reviving the ancient Pythian tradition through the Modern Pythian Games initiative.

item.title: Trump warns Iran conflict could last four more weeks amid escalating strikes; Full details
item.description: US President Donald Trump has warned that the escalating conflict with Iran could continue for up to four more weeks, citing firm strategic objectives. Recent airstrikes under “Operation Epic Fury” targeted key Iranian military assets, while Tehran responded with retaliatory attacks.

item.title: Gold, Silver surge as Middle East tensions rattle global markets; Check prices here
item.description: Gold and silver prices soared across global and domestic markets as escalating tensions in the Middle East boosted demand for safe-haven assets. COMEX gold climbed above $5,400 per ounce, while silver posted strong intraday gains.

item.title: Sensex plunges over 1,100 points amid Middle East Tensions; Nifty slips
item.description: Indian equity markets opened sharply lower as escalating Middle East tensions and surging crude oil prices triggered panic selling. The BSE Sensex fell over 1,100 points, while the Nifty 50 slipped below 24,850 in early trade.

item.title: Afghanistan strikes Pakistan’s Nur Khan Airbase; 35 soldiers reportedly killed
item.description: Tensions between Afghanistan and Pakistan have intensified after Afghan forces reportedly carried out airstrikes on Pakistan’s Nur Khan Airbase and other military facilities. Taliban officials claimed up to 35 Pakistani soldiers were killed and several bases damaged in retaliation for earlier Pakistani strikes on Kabul and Kandahar.

item.title: Air India cancels flights to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel and Qatar amid Middle East tensions
item.description: Amid escalating tensions in the Middle East following US-Israel-Iran conflicts, Air India has canceled all flights to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel, and Qatar until March 2, 11:59 PM IST. Several flights to Europe are also suspended, while alternate routes are being used for North America and European operations.

item.title: Iran interim Supreme Leader Alireza Arafi also reported dead; Full details here
item.description: Following the death of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in joint U.S.-Israeli attacks, Iranian authorities appointed Ali Reza Arafi to the three‑member interim Leadership Council. However, recent claims by a former U.S. National Security Adviser suggest that Arafi has also died.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Zimbabwe players stranded in India amid Israel-Iran tensions
item.description: T20 World Cup 2026 teams face travel disruptions due to escalating Israel-Iran tensions. Zimbabwe, eliminated from the tournament, is stranded in India as Dubai Airport operations are affected, delaying their return. Captain Sikandar Raza’s squad was scheduled to fly via Dubai, but flights are canceled.
